title: Exponential moment of a sign linear form
statement: Let $a_1,\ldots,a_n\in\mathbb R$, and choose $x$ uniformly from $\{-1,1\}^n$. Then $\mathbb E\exp\!\left(\sum_{i=1}^n a_i x_i\right)\leq \exp\!\left(\frac12\sum_{i=1}^n a_i^2\right)$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is a real-valued function on the finite index set $\{1,\ldots,n\}$
